notes: This records the environment used for the validated pre-final candidate; requirements.txt intentionally retains its supported version range.
A final build must record its actual package versions in BUILD_MANIFEST.json and must be re-audited if they differ.
PySide6_Pdf and PySide6_WebEngine were installed in the environment but were not collected into the minimized frozen distribution.
The maintained specification excludes the unused Qt PDF, QML, Quick, and Virtual Keyboard plugin chains.
